title: 第17章 他清楚自己将要面对的是一个怎样的怪物吗第18章 心之魔女 青春版
content_zh:
;;
在图书馆外和薇薇安告别，目送少女轻盈的身影消失在夜色中，克洛伊才转身走向自己的宿舍区。
学院夜晚的风很舒适，透着股慵懒的清爽意味，但他的心情却丝毫没有因此而轻松起来。
因为比起先前学习带来的疲惫，接下来他要面对的，才是真正让人头疼乃至恐惧的事情。
回到奢华却空旷的单人宿舍，克洛伊机械般地完成洗漱，换上柔软的睡衣。
他走到床边，却没有立刻躺下，而是静静地坐了一会儿。
窗外，学院的灯火大多已熄灭，只剩下零星几点，如同沉入黑暗前最后的星辰。
他深吸了一口气，又缓缓吐出，仿佛要将胸腔里那份沉重的压力一并排解，随即他又抬手用力拍了拍自己的脸颊，发出清脆的声响，低声自语：“没事没事，这不是坏事……死着死着就习惯了。
总有一天，要把那家伙按在地上摩擦，把场子找回来……”
话虽如此，当他真正躺下来，拉过被子时，脸上还是不由自主地浮现出一种近乎视死如归，仿佛奔赴刑场般的悲壮表情。
他闭上眼睛，努力放松身体，等待着那令人心悸的瞬间。
来了——
强烈的坠落感猛地攫住了他，意识被蛮横地拖拽而下。
视野再次清晰时，无边无际的水面与苍穹已然将他包围。
对面，那道持枪的身影静默矗立，如同亘古存在的死神雕像，散发着冰冷彻骨的杀意。
没有言语，没有迟疑。
当克洛伊站定的那一刻，一点寒芒便在他的眼中急剧放大。
克洛伊瞳孔猛一缩，随即本能般地抬枪横扫。
“锵——！”
新一轮的“死去活来”

之夜，便由此为发令枪，拉开序幕……
冰枪的穿刺，长枪的横扫，诡谲魔法的爆发……各种死法轮番上演，极致的痛苦被刻入灵魂深处。
克洛伊挣扎、反击、倒下，周而复始。
意识在清醒与湮灭间反复横跳，唯有那股不甘与倔强，支撑着他在每一次死亡后，再度拖着完好的身体，冲向那个不可战胜的身影。
时间在无数次生死轮回中失去意义。
直到窗外深沉的夜色开始透出熹微的晨光，克洛伊的精神与意志终于被压榨到了极限。
在一次被狂暴的冰霜魔力彻底撕碎后，他的意识没能再次于水面上凝聚，而是彻底沉入了无边的黑暗。
他昏死了过去。
宿舍床上，他的身体微微痉挛了一下，随即彻底平静下去。
......
晨光熹微，如同稀释的金色薄纱，轻柔地覆盖在皇家魔法学院沉睡的轮廓上。
content_en:
;;
After saying goodbye to Vivian outside the library and watching the girl's light figure disappear into the night, Chloe turned and walked towards her dormitory area.
The night breeze in the college was very comfortable, with a lazy and refreshing atmosphere, but his mood did not relax at all.
Because compared to the fatigue caused by previous studies, what he had to face next was something that was truly troublesome and even scary.
Returning to the luxurious but empty single dormitory, Chloe mechanically finished washing and put on soft pajamas.
He walked to the bed, but did not lie down immediately, but sat quietly for a while.
Outside the window, most of the lights in the college have been extinguished, leaving only a few scattered ones, like the last stars before sinking into darkness.
He took a deep breath and slowly exhaled it, as if to relieve the heavy pressure in his chest. Then he raised his hand and patted his cheek hard, making a crisp sound, and whispered to himself: "It's okay, it's okay, this is not a bad thing... I'll get used to it if I die."
One day, I will push that guy to the ground and rub him, and get the situation back..."
Having said that, when he actually lay down and pulled the quilt, a tragic expression appeared on his face that was almost as if he was looking forward to death, as if he was rushing to the execution ground.
He closed his eyes, tried to relax his body, and waited for that heart-stopping moment.
Coming——
A strong feeling of falling suddenly gripped him, and his consciousness was dragged down arbitrarily.
When his vision became clear again, he was surrounded by the boundless water and sky.
Opposite, the gun-wielding figure stood silently, like an eternal statue of the God of Death, exuding bone-cold murderous intent.
No words, no hesitation.
The moment Chloe stood still, a cold light suddenly magnified in his eyes.
Chloe's pupils shrank suddenly, and then she instinctively raised her gun and swept across.
"Qiang——!"
A new round of "life and death"
The night begins with this starting gun...
The piercing of the ice spear, the sweep of the spear, the burst of strange magic... Various ways of death were performed in turn, and the extreme pain was carved into the depths of the soul.
Chloe struggled, fought back, collapsed, over and over again.
His consciousness jumped repeatedly between wakefulness and annihilation. Only the unwillingness and stubbornness supported him to drag his intact body again after each death and rush towards the invincible figure.
Time loses its meaning in countless reincarnations of life and death.
Until the deep night outside the window began to reveal the faint morning light, Chloe's spirit and will were finally squeezed to the limit.
After being completely torn apart by the violent frost magic, his consciousness failed to condense on the water again, but completely sank into the boundless darkness.
He passed out.
On the bed in the dormitory, his body convulsed slightly, and then calmed down completely.
...
The faint morning light was like a diluted golden gauze, gently covering the sleeping outline of the Royal Academy of Magic.
